statement.text: For the canonical Boolean satisfiability problem SAT, SAT ∈ P if and only if P = NP; equivalently, SAT ∉ P if and only if P ≠ NP.

model.substitutionNote: No substitution to nonuniform circuits, algebraic circuits, or P/poly is permitted by this claim.

hypothesis: Any proof of SAT ∉ P in the canonical uniform deterministic polynomial-time model would imply P ≠ NP; any proof of SAT ∈ P would imply P = NP.

provenance.source: MCOP-PNP Lower-Bound Forge v0 / Cook-Levin canonical model
